recognize_zh: 中央大型細胞的胞質呈淡藍色、充滿纖維狀條紋（像「皺褶的絹紙」wrinkled tissue paper），核偏心，背景為增生的顆粒球系與嗜酸性顆粒，符合 CML 骨髓中的偽高雪氏細胞（pseudo-Gaucher cell）。
features: Large macrophage with abundant pale blue cytoplasm filled with fine fibrillary, striated 'wrinkled tissue paper' material
Single round, eccentric nucleus with coarse chromatin
Background of numerous granulocytic precursors and scattered eosinophilic granules
Adjacent megakaryocytic cells with multilobated nuclei (upper right)
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypercellular background with numerous granulocytic precursors, eosinophilic granules and megakaryocytic elements. A large histiocyte with abundant pale blue cytoplasm containing fibrillary, striated 'crinkled tissue paper' inclusions and a round eccentric nucleus is present in the center of the field. These pseudo-Gaucher cells reflect lipid accumulation from increased cell turnover. Findings are consistent with pseudo-Gaucher cells in the setting of chronic myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: Morphology is nearly identical; true Gaucher disease is excluded by low glucocerebrosidase activity/GBA mutation and lack of an underlying high-turnover neoplasm, and pseudo-Gaucher cells are often less strongly PAS/iron positive.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain discrete blue-green granules on Giemsa rather than fibrillary striated cytoplasm.
MAC histiocytes also show striated cytoplasm but contain acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain and appear as negative images on Romanowsky stain.
Niemann-Pick cells have finely vacuolated, bubbly foamy cytoplasm rather than fibrillary tissue-paper striations.
